$comment: The one GitHub App each org runs for pack sync, the expiry sentinel and the launcher. `org/apply.mjs create-app` fills `$`-placeholders from the overlay and submits it through GitHub's manifest flow. No webhook: the launcher polls. Permissions, each needed by a caller: actions write (launcher dispatches sync and expiry, reads their runs), actions_variables read (expiry reads credential issue dates), checks read and statuses read (verify and promote read head checks), contents write (branches, pack commits, evidence images, refs), issues write (claims, labels, compliance and expiry issues), pull_requests write (open, update, auto-merge, merge), workflows write (the pack ships std-gate.yml), metadata read (always).
name: $app_name
description: Standards sync, credential expiry sentinel and agent launcher for $org.
